entries.title: Luke 20:19
segments:
:26
 
Sought to lay hands on him in that very hour. The scribes and Pharisees, though seeking to lay hands on him, feared a riot if they attempted physical violence.  Therefore all their power was exerted in framing questions which were in tended to be legal traps, excuses for his authorized arrest and appearance before the Sanhedrin.  One of the most memorable of these questions concerned the lawfulness of giving tribute unto Caesar.  See notes on

entries.title: Luke 20:27
